hooks.command: bash -c 'for d in "$PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" .; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/scripts/pre_tool_use.sh" ] && exec bash "$d/scripts/pre_tool_use.sh"; done'
bash -c 'for d in "$PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" .; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/scripts/post_tool_use.sh" ] && exec bash "$d/scripts/post_tool_use.sh"; done'
bash -c 'for d in "$PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" .; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/cachelayer_tools/run_verify_hook.sh" ] && exec bash "$d/cachelayer_tools/run_verify_hook.sh"; done; printf "{}\n"'
